page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and an x86_64 architecture. It features 56 dedicated physical cores utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 224.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core CPU performance is weak, falling into the bottom 25% for stress-ng and Geekbench tests, with single-threaded gzip compression rated as poor. However, the instance leverages its high core count to achieve average multi-core performance across stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both small cached blocks and large uncached blocks remains in the average tier, supporting steady data throughput.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for highly parallelized workloads that can distribute tasks across 56 dedicated cores without requiring high single-thread performance. It is well-suited for multi-threaded decompression, static web serving, Redis database operations, and moderate LLM inference tasks using small to medium models. It is less suitable for single-threaded processing or applications requiring high-speed local NVMe storage.
